# Credit Loan Risk Assessment and Collateral Review

This document outlines key actions for the Credit & Loans department:

*   Review the collateral value quarterly.
*   Update the collateral value standard.
*   Review the default risk for strategy 2026.
*   Optimize the default risk based on audit findings.
*   Monitor the collateral value based on audit findings.
